What about art you've made? I'm a sort-of digital artist and I can see how someone might make an account just to share their own art on an art related subverse for example.

Sounds fine. But there should still be a good mix ratio of own content and 3rd party content being submitted. If you make an account to constantly share your own artwork (where only you can gain something, for example through ads), you should also share other content. Submitting your artwork once on a related sub does not require that you must also submit something else. Submitting your artwork through direct links to images is the safest way and does not require that you submit anything else. I hope this helps.
